skySemantics.description: Screen-reader description of the living sky behind the orbit, e.g. «السماء الآن: ليل. القمر بدر، مضاء بنسبة ٩٨٪»

skyMoodNight.description: Look of the sky: full night

skyMoodDawn.description: Look of the sky: morning twilight (from Fajr)

skyMoodSunrise.description: Look of the sky: the sun rising

skyMoodGoldenHour.description: Look of the sky: the low warm sun before sunset

skyMoodSunset.description: Look of the sky: the sun setting (Maghrib)

skyMoodDusk.description: Look of the sky: evening twilight after Maghrib

skyMoonBelow.en: The moon is below the horizon
skyMoonBelow.description: Screen-reader note when the moon has not risen

skyMoonPhase.description: Moon phase and illuminated fraction, e.g. «القمر بدر، مضاء بنسبة ٩٨٪»

skyStarNames.description: Toggle: show the traditional names of the brightest stars in the sky

skyStarNamesHint.ar: تُنقش الأسماء العربية لألمع النجوم في سماء الليل
skyStarNamesHint.en: Engraves the traditional Arabic names of the brightest stars in the night sky
